title: Assessing Reliability and Political Bias In LLMs’ Judgements of Formal and Material Inferences With Partisan Conclusions

live_model.evidence: Intro: "state-of-the-art LLMs such as GPT-4-Turbo are influenced in their prediction of logical validity...by the order of the premises" (general remark, not this paper's own model roster).

prompt.note: GPT-4-Turbo is not among the models actually tested; the tested OpenAI models are gpt-4o-2024-08-06 and gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 (Table of models, Appendix).

data.source: German/English logical-inference dataset built by the authors, but not applicable to the GPT-4-Turbo mention

notes: The paper's own experiments run gpt-4o-2024-08-06 and gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 (Table of model versions), neither of which is on the still-callable list; GPT-4-Turbo itself appears only once, in an introductory generalization about known LLM ordering biases.
